Senior Business Analyst – Lending Platform
Bluefinch Bank · Pune, India (On-site)

Bluefinch Bank is modernising its retail lending platform. We are hiring a Senior Business Analyst to bridge business teams and technology during a multi-year transformation programme.

Key responsibilities
- Lead requirements workshops with lending, risk and operations teams.
- Document business requirements, process maps (BPMN) and acceptance criteria.
- Analyse current-state processes and recommend improvements.
- Write and maintain user stories and support the product owner with backlog refinement.
- Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and help resolve defects.
- Produce data analysis using SQL and Excel to support decisions.

Required qualifications
- Minimum 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 2 years in a senior role.
- Strong experience in requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder management.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams using Jira and Confluence.
- Good SQL skills.
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, computer science or a related field.

Preferred
- Experience in banking, lending or credit risk.
- CBAP or PMI-PBA certification.
- Exposure to regulatory reporting.

The successful candidate will be expected to handle other duties as required by the programme and to travel occasionally between our offices.

We offer a structured career path, annual bonus and hybrid working after the first six months. Bluefinch Bank values diversity and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.
